name: MDMB-CHMICA
summary: MDMB-CHMICA is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug. While MDMB-CHMICA was initially sold under the name "MMB-CHMINACA", the compound corresponding to this code name has been identified on the designer drug market in 2015 as AMB-CHMINACA.

pharmacology.text: MDMB-CHMICA acts as a highly potent full agonist of the CB1 receptor with an efficacy of 94% and an EC50 value of 0.14 nM, which is approximately 8 times lower than the EC50 of JWH-018 (1.13 nM) and twofold lower than AB-CHMINACA (0.27 nM).

uses.text: MDMB-CHMICA is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.text: Seventy-one serious adverse events, including 42 acute intoxications and 29 deaths (Germany (5), Hungary (3), Poland (1), Sweden (9), United Kingdom (10), Norway (1)) that occurred in nine European countries between 2014 and 2016 have been associated with MDMB-CHMICA.

fact.en: It was first sold under the name MMB-CHMINACA, but analysis showed the product was a different compound, so it was renamed MDMB-CHMICA, with ICA marking its indole core rather than an indazole.
fact.zh: 它最初以 MMB-CHMINACA 之名販售，但分析發現產品其實是另一種化合物，於是改名為 MDMB-CHMICA，其中「ICA」表示它的核心是吲哚而非吲唑。
